reserve_profile.summary: StandX describes DUSD as backed by base assets including USDT and managed through hedged positions; available documentation alone does not establish current total reserves, custody details, auditor assurance or redemption capacity following the wind-down announcement.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: USDT or supported assets, subject to operator process
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: StandX documentation says DUSD is redeemable regardless of acquisition method, subject to portfolio/wallet, minimum, fees and operator order validation.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Protocol redemption fees may apply and actual amounts are shown before confirmation. Official FAQ refers to 0.1%, while redemption documentation describes variable fee components.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Standard seven-day lock period after requesting redemption per operator documentation; closure announcement gives January 31, 2027 as the latest redemption request deadline.
